episodes.title: Capítulo 1
episodes.summary: Jailed ex-policeman Miguel Palacios is tasked with infiltrating a Buenos Aires prison to help a judge find out who kidnapped his daughter.

episodes.title: Capítulo 2
episodes.summary: Pastor Peña continues to develop his plan to get closer to the Borges brothers. Meanwhile, his own brother brings him unexpected news.

episodes.title: Capítulo 3
episodes.summary: Pastor struggles to make contact with Luna. Emma is threatened when she tries to tell the truth about Diosito. Fernando confronts Lunati.

episodes.title: Capítulo 4
episodes.summary: Diosito starts to get suspicious of Pastor and his intentions. An inmate's depression worsens. Lunati demands he get his daughter back.

episodes.title: Capítulo 5
episodes.summary: Luna's transfer from the prison becomes an increasingly dangerous endeavor. Lunati follows through on his threat. Pastor comforts Emma after a loss.

episodes.title: Capítulo 6
episodes.summary: Pastor learns troubling news about his family. The attorney general begins an investigation into recent incidents in the prison.

episodes.title: Capítulo 7
episodes.summary: A flashback reveals more about Pastor's past life as Miguel. In the present, Pastor is consumed by the need to find his missing son.

episodes.title: Capítulo 8
episodes.summary: Antín makes good on his promise, but adds a few conditions. Emma's assistance in Pastor's search for his son leads her to a shocking discovery.

episodes.title: Capítulo 9
episodes.summary: Vengeful behavior runs rampant in the San Onofre prison and the stakes couldn't get any higher. Antín worries he has lost control of his inmates.

episodes.title: Capítulo 10
episodes.summary: Emma checks in on Pastor's mother. The feud between the Borges brothers and Sub 21 continues while Antín worries his lies will catch up to him.

episodes.title: Capítulo 11
episodes.summary: Gastón raises the pressure on the warden. Emma finds a lead while looking for Pastor's son. Borges plots his revenge on Sub 21.

episodes.title: Capítulo 12
episodes.summary: A prisoner remembers Pastor from his days as a police officer. Gastón is intrigued by rumors about Pastor and Emma's romantic relationship.

episodes.title: Capítulo 13
episodes.summary: Pastor continues to plan his escape but Emma is concerned he is putting himself at risk. More people learn about Pastor's real identity.

episodes.title: Capítulo 1
episodes.summary: Three years before the fire, Borges escapes one prison only to end up in another alongside his brother Diosito. Emma starts her first day of work.

episodes.title: Capítulo 2
episodes.summary: A call from the prison demanding ransom for a fake kidnapping ends fatally. A threatened Patricio meets with El Sapo. The warden offers Borges a deal.

episodes.title: Capítulo 3
episodes.summary: The guards search for a missing Ontiveros. Borges, Diosito and Patricio try to cover up a crime. El Sapo celebrates his daughter's 15th birthday.

episodes.title: Capítulo 4
episodes.summary: Borges and his men worry that El Sapo will retaliate because of the call center attack. The police investigate San Onofre.

episodes.title: Capítulo 5
episodes.summary: Borges and El Sapo confront each other as tensions rise among their groups and Cuis gets involved. Emma discovers more about the prostitution ring.

episodes.title: Capítulo 6
episodes.summary: Camila confesses the truth about her husband's murder, but Patricio remains in trouble. While El Sapo is gone, Morcilla and Borges consider a ceasefire.

episodes.title: Capítulo 7
episodes.summary: Emma reports the prostitution ring to Garófalo, who takes action. Diosito receives a disturbing letter. A riot begins in the prison.

episodes.title: Capítulo 8
episodes.summary: Diosito helps save Patricio. Rita's life is in danger, along with many others', as the riot intensifies and leaves multiple victims wounded and dead.

episodes.title: Capítulo 1
episodes.summary: Mario cuts two deals: one to look out for a young privileged newbie in exchange for freedom for himself and Diosito, and the other with a vicious narco.

episodes.title: Capítulo 2
episodes.summary: Mario assigns Diosito to take care of the newbie, Moco, but Diosito decides to give him a crash course in criminality. Emma suffers post-riot trauma.

episodes.title: Capítulo 3
episodes.summary: Mario falls behind on his narco debt and forces his prison chemist into new heights of creativity. Meanwhile, Moco gets high to drown his troubles.

episodes.title: Capítulo 4
episodes.summary: The new business is going well but Diosito is devastated when he learns Mario's been keeping information from him. Moco realizes he's in danger.

episodes.title: Capítulo 5
episodes.summary: Pantera, Mario's personal prisoner, is released by a rival faction and wreaks havoc on the Borges' enterprises. Emma falls deeper into addiction.

episodes.title: Capítulo 6
episodes.summary: Mario has a catastrophic business setback. Diosito, who survives a near fatal beating, brutally confronts him. Moco realizes he's on the wrong side.

episodes.title: Capítulo 7
episodes.summary: Mario and Diosito continue to argue while Moco, now without protection, makes a decision. After a prison crackdown, Bruni masterminds a takeover.

episodes.title: Capítulo 8
episodes.summary: Bruni uses Pantera as his personal attack dog against the Borges while the chemist, Tubito, stalks Emma. Rival prison authorities fight for control.
